18.t: Working with data: I-V for two components
q: Read the current through the lamp at 3 V.
Calculate the resistance of the resistor with R = V / I.
Calculate the resistance of the lamp at 1 V and at 6 V.
Explain the shape of the lamp’s graph.

As the current rises, the filament gets hotter; its atoms vibrate more and get in the way of electrons, so the resistance increases and the graph curves. The resistor stays cool, so it obeys Ohm’s law.
